notes: No model is shipped or pinned by default. User chooses at runtime/serve time.
Local-only smoke test default for dev: ollama/qwen2.5-coder:1.5b (optional, not shipped). PRs must not add a bundled model.

rules: Keep at least 8GB VRAM free on B70 while CodeRed-418 training runs. No training-context allocation from EHC.
EHC rendering (Electron/Chromium) pins to primaryCard (7900 XTX) unless user changes. B70 reserved for training.
No heavy GPU compute in dev/CI while training is active. Small Qwen smoke tests only, on primary card.
On window/session close, kill its LSP/DAP and child processes promptly. Never leave orphaned node/python/lldb.
Before any GPU/CPU heavy step (GGUF quant, image build, docker VM), check headroom and ask. Stop at the heavy spot.

notes: Agnostic defaults are always scanned first: ~/.eventhorizon/models + ./models (created by runtime:init).
ggufDirs below are machine-specific ADDITIONS. Users add folders via Model Manager > Choose folder.
binaryPath is machine-specific; leave empty on other machines to use the packaged resources/engine binary ladder.
gpu.policy per docs/GPU.md: deviceIndex pins a card, heapFraction caps the Chonk pool, pool=1 enables cross-vendor Chonk Buffer.
Installers ship resources/engine/ with pinned chonkllama release binaries (verified by SHA).
Opt-in deterministic line-manager. Default OFF. Operator review paramount. Deterministic guide, not a judge.
When off: no subprocess, no gating, no badge.
Detonation lane only. Clean worktrees never receive untrusted code.
BlackICE engram_vm pattern: pyvm, rv32, ti85, mathcheck, dataflow. Deterministic, no syscalls.
Model Gemma-4-12b-RedTeam-BlackICE is user-chosen at runtime if wanted (ChonkE/Gemma-4-12b-RedTeam-BlackICE on HF). Not shipped, not default.
